component.name: Kakarot
component.summary: Autonomous, memory-bounded desktop agent for GNOME

description.p: Kakarot is a local AI desktop agent for GNOME. It listens for voice, plans multi-step tasks, and carries them out on your desktop while everything stays on your machine.
A floating mascot shows what it is doing and answers questions in a speech bubble. Right-click it to force listening, run a single command, or update your Gemini API key.

ul.li: Voice in, spoken replies out, through the daemon
Read-only inspection runs instantly; anything mutating waits for your approval
Commands run inside a Bubblewrap sandbox with no network by default
Secrets are redacted before anything leaves the machine
Every autonomous action is written to an auditable log

description.p: Floating mascot front end and a Bubblewrap-sandboxed execute path.
